description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    Music majors only. A development of the fundamental skills of the piano, emphasizing those aspects most useful to non-piano majors. A knowledge of scales and chords is stressed, as is sight reading, improvisation, playing in all keys, and harmonizing melodies.
    
</section>
